name: pm-kanban-root
description: Root workspace orchestrating frontend and backend builds

scripts.copy:frontend: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('backend/public', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('frontend/out', 'backend/public', { recursive: true }); console.log('Copied frontend/out to backend/public');"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run copy:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test:all: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
